description:
Quote the maximum hold for LightX recamera; nothing is charged.

Required video_url is an owned source video (at least 49/24 seconds and at most 15 seconds, up to 100 MB).
Pass camera='traj' with trajectory (theta, phi, radius arrays) or camera='target' with 5-element
target_pose, plus recamera_mode gradual (default), bullet, direct or dolly-zoom. Original audio is
preserved. Pass cost_rub as max_cost_rub when creating; bullet holds at least 10 seconds, standard
modes at least 5 seconds, or ceil(source seconds), settled to actual invoice later.

target_pose.description: Required when camera='target'; 5-element target pose [theta, phi, radius, x, y].
target_pose.title: Target Pose

trajectory.description: Required when camera='traj'; theta, phi, and radius arrays.

video_url.description: Source video from your own uploads or results; at least 49/24 seconds and at most 15 seconds.
video_url.title: Video Url

name: estimate_lightx_recamera
